intro.label: How we work
intro.p1: We are a small practice in Chicó: four specialists, three treatment rooms with natural light, and one rule — nobody is in a hurry.
intro.p2: Every appointment lasts a full hour. Nobody walks in while you are in the chair, and there is never someone waiting for your slot.
intro.p3: We use computer-controlled anesthesia, which goes in slowly and is barely noticeable. Raise your hand and we stop. Always.
intro.p4: Before we touch a tooth, you get a fixed, written quote. What you sign is what you pay.
intro.p5: If it has been years since you saw a dentist, start here: what your first visit looks like.

letter.label: A letter from our founder, and the team
letter.p1: I opened Clínica Dental Chicó in 2019, after twelve years in clinics where every patient got twenty minutes. Twenty minutes is not enough to explain anything — least of all to someone who walks in afraid.
letter.p2: Here, every appointment lasts an hour. I explain what I see before I do anything, and you watch what I do on the screen. If anything feels uncomfortable, <mark>raise your hand and we stop</mark>.
letter.p3: There are four of us. Andrés does root canals under the microscope, Laura leads orthodontics, Camila is the hygienist you will see twice a year, and I handle restorative work and implants.
letter.p4: We don't do promotions or package deals. We have one price per treatment, in writing, and all the time it takes.
letter.role: Dentist, restorative dentistry. Founder of Clínica Dental Chicó.

smile.title: Smile design
smile.lead: A smile planned around your face, your proportions and the way you laugh. You try it on before you decide.
smile.body: We don't start from a catalog of perfect teeth. We study your photos, your bite and what you would like to change, then combine only the treatments your case actually needs. The goal is for you to look like yourself, with teeth that look healthy and natural.
smile.photoNote: Reference photographs, not patients of the clinic.
smile.inc1d: Thin shells that change the shape, size or color of your front teeth. Before we make them, we show them to you in wax.
smile.inc2d: Lightens the shade of your own teeth. It is often the first step, and sometimes the only one.
smile.inc3d: Fixes chipped edges, small gaps or dark fillings in a single visit.
smile.inc4d: If your teeth need to move, aligning them first can spare them from being reshaped later.
smile.includesNote: Each plan combines only what your case needs. It might be a whitening session, or treatment in several stages.
smile.ph1d: Photos, X-rays and a conversation about what you would like to change — and what you wouldn't.
smile.ph2d: We design your new smile and try it in your mouth, in wax, so you can see it before we touch a tooth.
smile.ph3d: In stages and in one-hour appointments, with the plan and price in writing from day one.
smile.ph4d: Check-ups to see how your mouth adapts and how to care for the result at home.
smile.aim1d: Teeth that suit your face, your lips and the way you smile.
smile.aim2d: A white that looks healthy, not one you notice from across the room.
smile.aim3d: When the result allows it, we choose the option that removes the least tooth structure.
smile.aim4d: You see the proposal, you know the price, and you decide without pressure.
smile.honest: Every mouth is different and results vary from case to case. At your assessment we will tell you honestly what is possible and what isn't.

impl.title: Dental implants
impl.lead: A titanium root that replaces a missing tooth and supports a porcelain crown.
impl.body: The implant is placed in the bone during a short, planned procedure. Once the bone has bonded with it, a crown made to fit your mouth is attached on top. The neighboring teeth don't need to be reshaped.
impl.s1d: We review your general health, your gums and the bone in the area with X-rays, and tell you whether an implant is a good option for you.
impl.s2d: We plan the implant position on a computer before surgery, and give you the plan and price in writing.
impl.s3d: Under local anesthesia, in one appointment. Most patients return to their routine the next day, with clear instructions for the first few days.
impl.s4d: Once the implant is stable, we take impressions and place your final porcelain crown.
impl.s5d: Regular reviews and professional cleanings to look after the implant and the gum around it.
impl.timeBody: As a guide, the final crown is usually placed 3 to 6 months after the implant — the time the bone needs to integrate it. Your plan will give you your own timeline, which may be longer if you need a bone graft.
impl.f1: The amount and quality of bone in the area.
impl.benefitsTitle: What an implant can give you
impl.b1d: The crown rests on bone, not on the gum.
impl.b2d: Unlike a bridge, the teeth on either side don't need to be filed down.
impl.b3d: The implant stimulates the bone in the area, which tends to shrink when a tooth is missing.
impl.b4d: The crown is made to match the color and shape of your teeth.
impl.honest: Like any treatment, an implant needs good home care and regular check-ups. How long it lasts depends on that care and on your general health.

faq.title: Questions
faq.a1: Hardly ever. First we apply a gel that numbs the gum, then the anesthetic is delivered drop by drop by a computer-controlled device, which is what avoids the sharp sting.
faq.q2: What if I panic in the chair?
faq.a2: Raise your hand and we stop, no questions asked. You can bring headphones, ask for breaks and, for longer procedures, choose conscious sedation.
faq.a3: We work on a reimbursement basis: we give you the invoice and the documents your insurer asks for. We are not part of the Colombian public health system (EPS).
faq.a4: One hour. If the treatment needs less, the extra time is for your questions.
faq.a5: From age 4. A child's first visit is just to get to know the room and count teeth.
faq.a6: Yes. You pay for each appointment when it ends, and longer treatments can be split into up to 12 interest-free installments on a credit card.
faq.a7: Monday to Saturday we keep two slots a day for pain. Message us on WhatsApp before 10 a.m.
faq.q8: What if I can't make it?
faq.a8: Let us know 24 hours ahead and we'll move your appointment at no cost. We give that slot to an emergency.
faq.q9: Do aligners work for every case?
faq.a9: For most. At your assessment we show you the simulation, and if your case is better suited to braces, we'll tell you.
faq.q10: How often should I come back?
faq.a10: Every six months for a cleaning and check-up. We'll message you when it's time.
faq.a11: Yes, in the building's basement, with two hours free. You can also walk from the Calle 93 station.
faq.q12: I'm coming from abroad — how many days should I stay?
faq.a12: It depends on the treatment. Whitening or bonding can be done in a few days; veneers need several appointments; implants usually require two trips a few months apart. We give you an estimate before you travel and confirm it at your assessment.
faq.q13: Can I know the cost before I travel?
faq.a13: We can give you a guide range based on the information you send us. The fixed price is given in writing after your in-person assessment, because only then can we confirm the diagnosis.
faq.q14: What about follow-up once I'm home?
faq.a14: We give you your plan, your X-rays and written recommendations so your local dentist can follow up. For any questions, we stay in touch on WhatsApp.

frio.note: Pain with cold or sweets is often a small cavity or an exposed root surface.

morderCordal.note: A wisdom tooth that hurts when you bite is often inflamed or poorly positioned. The X-ray will show us.

morder.note: Pain when biting, or pain that appears for no reason, often comes from the nerve. We treat it under a microscope, without rushing.

rotoFront.note: A small chip can be rebuilt in one visit; for a larger break we may suggest a veneer.

rotoBack.note: A cracked molar needs a piece that holds it together. We design it and try it in before bonding.

faltaCordal.note: A missing wisdom tooth rarely needs replacing. If it's loose, we check the gum and bone.

falta.note: If the tooth is loose, we try to save it first. If it's missing, an implant replaces it without touching the teeth beside it.

esteticaFront.note: Whitening is often enough. Before any veneer, we show you the result in wax.

esteticaBack.what: Replacing a metal filling with a tooth-colored one
esteticaBack.note: Dark fillings are replaced with tooth-colored material, one surface at a time.
